newsitem.title: USA: Actor Tim Allen penalized for drunk driving.
newsitem.headline: Actor Tim Allen penalized for drunk driving.

text.p: Actor Tim Allen must pay a fine and attend alcohol counselling sessions after the star of TV's "Home Improvement" pleaded guilty to driving while impaired last month, his lawyer said Wednesday.

Allen, 43, apologised in a suburban district court for the May 23 episode in which he was caught driving his Ferrari 70 miles per hour in a 40 mph zone. He failed a sobriety test when stopped in this suburb of Detroit .

The court, in a decision issued Tuesday, also restricted Allen's driving privileges to work-related trips for 90 days, ordered him to attend at least six counselling sessions and put him on probation for a year.
Allen, whose real name is Timothy Alan Dick, keeps a home in the Detroit area and his mother lives here. His father died after being hit by a drunken driver.

In a statement released by his Los Angeles publicist, Allen sounded contrite: "I have been treated fairly by the authorities in my home town, however, my inexcusable lapse in judgment is a mistake that is embarrassing to myself, my family and my associates. I have learned from this experience and I am fortunate that my family and associates have forgiven me."
Allen served 28 months in prison for selling cocaine in 1978. Subsequently, his stand-up comedy blossomed into a film and television career and he has penned a best-selling book.
